description: Read one agent's Value Receipt, measured: its signals over the period with the human value the workspace set for each, what it cost (Last Price compute plus costs recorded in the workspace) and the return when both are known. A figure that cannot be measured is null, with the reason under missing. Pass agent_id, and start_date and end_date to choose the period (default the last 30 days, at most 366). An agent's own credential reads only its own receipt. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: The agent: its id, as it shows in your workspace. An agent's own credential can name only its own agent.

end_date.description: The end of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

start_date.description: The start of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

name: get_agent_value_receipt
